milestones.title: M0 Foundation
milestones.description: Monorepo, workspace, lints, CI, app runs on Android + Windows, server "hello world".

milestones.title: M2 Quiz authoring
milestones.description: Quiz library, quiz editor, question editor, JSON import/export.

milestones.title: M3 Quiz taking & evaluation
milestones.description: Player, timer, scoring, results and review screens, attempts saved.

milestones.title: M4 Metrics
milestones.description: Per-quiz stats, weakest questions, global dashboard with charts.

milestones.title: M5 Flashcards
milestones.description: Decks, card editor, study session, SM-2 scheduling, due counts.

milestones.title: M6 Server
milestones.description: Postgres schema, auth, quizzes/decks endpoints, search, Docker.

milestones.title: M7 Sync & catalog
milestones.description: Login in app, publish, browse/search catalog, download, updates, conflicts.

milestones.title: M8 Polish & release
milestones.description: Responsive desktop layout, theming/dark mode, accessibility, tests, Android & Windows release builds.

issues.title: Set up Dart pub workspace monorepo
issues.body:
Create the monorepo described in docs/PLAN.md §3.

**Done when**
- [ ] Root `pubspec.yaml` declares a pub workspace with `app/`, `server/`, `packages/quiz_core/`
- [ ] Root `analysis_options.yaml` (`lints/recommended` + strict casts)
- [ ] Root `.gitignore` ignores build output and generated `*.g.dart` / `*.freezed.dart`
- [ ] `dart pub get` from the root resolves the whole workspace

issues.title: Create quiz_core package skeleton
issues.body:
Pure Dart package shared by app and server (`packages/quiz_core`).

**Done when**
- [ ] Package with `lib/src/{models,validation,scoring,srs}` folders and a public barrel file
- [ ] freezed, json_serializable and build_runner configured
- [ ] `dart test` runs with a sample test
- [ ] No Flutter or server-only dependencies

issues.title: Create Flutter app scaffold for Android and Windows
issues.body:
Flutter client in `app/` targeting Android and Windows only.

**Done when**
- [ ] `app/` created with Android and Windows platforms (app name StudyBetter)
- [ ] `app/analysis_options.yaml` builds on `flutter_lints`
- [ ] Depends on `quiz_core` via the workspace
- [ ] `flutter run -d windows` and an Android emulator both start the app
- [ ] Feature-first folders under `lib/` (`app/`, `data/`, `features/`)

issues.title: App shell: Riverpod, go_router, theme and navigation
issues.body:
Bootstrap the app so features can be plugged in.

**Done when**
- [ ] `ProviderScope` and app bootstrap in `lib/app/`
- [ ] go_router with placeholder routes: Quizzes, Flashcards, Stats, Catalog, Settings
- [ ] Material 3 theme
- [ ] Navigation rail on wide screens, bottom navigation bar on narrow screens

issues.title: Server hello world with health endpoint
issues.body:
Dart shelf server in `server/`.

**Done when**
- [ ] `bin/server.dart` serves `GET /api/v1/health` → `200 {"status":"ok"}`
- [ ] Config (port, DB URL, JWT secret) read from environment in `lib/config.dart`
- [ ] Request logging middleware
- [ ] One route test for `/health`

issues.title: Docker Compose for PostgreSQL and server
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] `server/Dockerfile` (AOT-compiled server)
- [ ] `docker-compose.yml` with `db` (PostgreSQL) and `server` services
- [ ] `docker compose up -d db` gives a database the server can reach locally
- [ ] Example env file documented in README

issues.title: CI: format, analyze and test on GitHub Actions
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Workflow runs on PRs and pushes to `main`
- [ ] Runs `build_runner`, `dart format --set-exit-if-changed .`, `dart analyze`
- [ ] Runs tests for `quiz_core`, `app` and `server`
- [ ] README shows the CI badge

issues.title: quiz_core: Quiz, Question, Option and QuizSettings models
issues.body:
Models for the quiz document in docs/PLAN.md §4.

**Done when**
- [ ] freezed models with `toJson` / `fromJson` for all quiz fields (`schemaVersion`, `kind`, `id`, `version`, timestamps, `settings`, `questions`)
- [ ] `QuestionType` enum: `single`, `multiple`
- [ ] JSON round-trip tests using the sample document from the plan

issues.title: quiz_core: FlashcardDeck and Flashcard models
issues.body:
Models for the deck document in docs/PLAN.md §4.

**Done when**
- [ ] freezed models with JSON support (`kind: flashcardDeck`, `cards` with `front`, `back`, `hint`)
- [ ] JSON round-trip tests

issues.title: quiz_core: document validation
issues.body:
Pure validation functions used by the app editor and by the server on upload.

**Done when**
- [ ] Quiz rules: ≥1 question, 2–10 options per question, ≥1 correct option, `single` ⇒ exactly one correct, unique ids, non-empty text
- [ ] Deck rules: ≥1 card, unique ids, non-empty front/back
- [ ] Returns a list of errors with a path (e.g. `questions[2].options`) rather than throwing
- [ ] Unit tests for every rule

issues.title: quiz_core: schemaVersion handling and migrations
issues.body:
Parse any supported document version into the current model.

**Done when**
- [ ] `parseDocument(Map json)` reads `kind` and `schemaVersion` and dispatches
- [ ] Migration pipeline `vN → vN+1` (empty for v1, but tested with a fake v0)
- [ ] Clear error for unknown `kind` or a newer-than-supported `schemaVersion`
- [ ] Sample v1 documents kept under `test/fixtures/`

issues.title: docs: data-format.md reference
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] `docs/data-format.md` documents quiz and deck documents field by field, validation rules and versioning policy
- [ ] Linked from README and PLAN

issues.title: Drift database with all local tables
issues.body:
Local database from docs/PLAN.md §5.

**Done when**
- [ ] Tables: `quizzes`, `attempts`, `attempt_answers`, `decks`, `card_reviews`, `review_log`, `settings`
- [ ] Works on Android and Windows (sqlite3 bundled)
- [ ] Schema version and migration strategy in place
- [ ] Tests with an in-memory database

issues.title: Quiz and deck repositories
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] `QuizRepository` and `DeckRepository`: watch list, get by id, save (bumps `version` and `updatedAt`), duplicate, soft delete
- [ ] Stores the full document as JSON text plus denormalized columns (title, tags, origin, remote fields)
- [ ] Exposed through Riverpod providers
- [ ] Repository tests with in-memory Drift

issues.title: Attempt and review-state repositories
issues.body:
Personal data that never goes into the shared document.

**Done when**
- [ ] `AttemptRepository`: save attempt with per-question answers, list attempts per quiz
- [ ] `ReviewRepository`: read/write per-card review state and append to `review_log`
- [ ] Repository tests

issues.title: Quiz library screen
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Lists local quizzes (title, question count, tags, last updated)
- [ ] Search by title and filter by tag
- [ ] Actions: open, play, edit, duplicate, delete (with undo)
- [ ] Empty state with "Create quiz" and "Import"

issues.title: Quiz editor: metadata and settings
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Edit title, description, language, tags
- [ ] Settings: shuffle questions, shuffle options, time limit, passing score %
- [ ] Question list with add, delete and drag-to-reorder
- [ ] Unsaved-changes warning on leave

issues.title: Question editor
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Prompt, type (single / multiple), 2–10 options, mark correct option(s)
- [ ] Optional explanation and points
- [ ] Switching to `single` with several correct options asks which one to keep
- [ ] Widget tests

issues.title: Show validation errors in the quiz editor
issues.body:
Use `quiz_core` validation in the editor.

**Done when**
- [ ] Errors shown next to the offending field / question
- [ ] Saving an invalid quiz is allowed as draft but playing/exporting is blocked with a clear message

issues.title: Import and export quizzes as JSON files
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Export a quiz to a `.json` file (save dialog on Windows, share/save on Android)
- [ ] Import from a file: parse with migrations, validate, show errors
- [ ] Importing a quiz whose id already exists offers "replace" or "import as copy"
- [ ] Exported files re-import identically (round-trip test)

issues.title: quiz_core: scoring
issues.body:
Pure scoring functions.

**Done when**
- [ ] Score a question: correct only if the selected set equals the correct set; unanswered = skipped
- [ ] Score an attempt: points, max points, percent, pass/fail vs `passingScorePercent`, correct/incorrect/skipped counts
- [ ] Unit tests incl. multi-answer and skipped cases

issues.title: Quiz player screen
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] One question at a time with progress indicator
- [ ] Radio buttons for `single`, checkboxes for `multiple`
- [ ] Shuffles questions/options per quiz settings
- [ ] Next / previous / skip, finish with confirmation if questions are unanswered
- [ ] Keyboard shortcuts on desktop (1–9 select, Enter next)
- [ ] Logic in a Riverpod controller with unit tests

issues.title: Quiz time limit and per-question timing
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Countdown when `timeLimitSeconds` is set; auto-finish at zero
- [ ] Time spent per question recorded in milliseconds
- [ ] Timer pauses when the app goes to background on Android

issues.title: Save attempts with per-question answers
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Finishing a quiz stores an attempt (quizId, quizVersion, start/finish, score, max score, duration) and every answer (selected ids, correct?, time ms)
- [ ] Abandoned attempts are not saved

issues.title: Results screen
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Shows score (points and %), pass/fail, correct/incorrect/skipped, total and average time per question
- [ ] Buttons: review answers, retry, back to library

issues.title: Answer review screen
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Every question with the user's answer vs the correct answer and the explanation
- [ ] Filter: all / incorrect only
- [ ] Reachable from results and from attempt history

issues.title: Stats queries for attempts
issues.body:
Drift queries feeding the metrics screens.

**Done when**
- [ ] Per quiz: attempt count, best / average / last score, scores over time, average time per question
- [ ] Per question: accuracy across attempts (handles questions removed in later quiz versions)
- [ ] Global: quizzes taken, questions answered, overall accuracy, attempts per day for last 30 days
- [ ] Tests with seeded data

issues.title: Per-quiz stats screen with score trend chart
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Summary tiles: attempts, best, average, last score
- [ ] fl_chart line chart of score % per attempt with the passing line
- [ ] Attempt history list linking to the review screen

issues.title: Weakest questions and practice mode
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Per-question accuracy list sorted weakest first on the quiz stats screen
- [ ] "Practice weakest questions" starts the player with the N lowest-accuracy questions
- [ ] Practice attempts are marked as practice and excluded from the main score trend

issues.title: Global stats dashboard
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Totals: quizzes taken, questions answered, overall accuracy
- [ ] 30-day activity chart (attempts per day)
- [ ] Flashcard section: due today, cards learned, review streak, retention rate (once M5 lands)

issues.title: quiz_core: SM-2 spaced repetition scheduler
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] `ReviewState next(ReviewState current, Grade grade, DateTime now)` as a pure function
- [ ] Grades Again / Hard / Good / Easy map to SM-2 quality 0 / 3 / 4 / 5
- [ ] Tracks ease factor (min 1.3), interval, repetitions, due date, lapses
- [ ] Unit tests for each grade, lapses and ease floor

issues.title: Deck library and deck editor
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Deck list with card count and due count
- [ ] Create / edit / duplicate / delete decks (title, description, language, tags)
- [ ] Card list inside the deck editor with add, delete and reorder

issues.title: Flashcard editor
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Edit front, back and optional hint
- [ ] "Save and add next" for fast entry
- [ ] Validation via `quiz_core`

issues.title: Flashcard study session
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Shows front, tap/space to flip, grade Again / Hard / Good / Easy (keys 1–4 on desktop)
- [ ] "Due cards" mode updates review state via SM-2 and logs each review
- [ ] "Cram all cards" mode does not change scheduling
- [ ] Session summary at the end

issues.title: Daily new-card limit, due counts and streaks
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Setting for new cards per day (default 20)
- [ ] Due counts per deck and in total
- [ ] Review streak (consecutive days with ≥1 review)

issues.title: Import and export decks as JSON files
issues.body:
Same behaviour as quiz import/export, for decks.

**Done when**
- [ ] Export / import `.json` decks with validation and id-conflict handling
- [ ] Review state is never exported

issues.title: PostgreSQL schema and migration runner
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] SQL migrations in `server/migrations/` for `users`, `refresh_tokens`, `quizzes`, `decks` (columns from docs/PLAN.md §8)
- [ ] `tsvector` index on title/description/tags
- [ ] Migrations run automatically at startup and are tracked in a table

issues.title: Auth: register, login, refresh and JWT middleware
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] `POST /auth/register`, `/auth/login`, `/auth/refresh`; `GET /me`
- [ ] Passwords hashed with argon2 or bcrypt
- [ ] Short-lived access token + rotating refresh token stored hashed
- [ ] Middleware sets the current user; 401 on missing/invalid token

issues.title: Quiz endpoints
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] `GET /quizzes/{id}`, `POST /quizzes`, `PUT /quizzes/{id}`, `DELETE /quizzes/{id}`, `GET /me/quizzes`
- [ ] Every upload validated with `quiz_core`; 422 with error list on failure
- [ ] `PUT` requires `If-Match: <version>`; 409 on mismatch
- [ ] Only the owner can update/delete; private quizzes only visible to the owner

issues.title: Deck endpoints
issues.body: Same set of endpoints and rules as quizzes, under `/decks`.

issues.title: Public catalog search and paging
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] `GET /quizzes?q=&tag=&sort=&page=` and the same for `/decks`
- [ ] Returns summaries only (no full document), public items only
- [ ] Full-text search, tag filter, sort by newest / most downloaded
- [ ] Download count incremented on `GET /{id}`

issues.title: Server protection: size limits and rate limiting
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Request body limit (1 MB) → 413
- [ ] Rate limiting on auth endpoints → 429
- [ ] CORS / error handler returns JSON errors without stack traces

issues.title: Server route tests against a throwaway Postgres
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Test harness starts/cleans a Postgres database (Docker) per test run
- [ ] Tests: auth flow, ownership, validation errors, version conflicts, search
- [ ] Runs in CI

issues.title: docs: api.md REST reference
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] `docs/api.md` documents every endpoint with request/response examples and error codes
- [ ] Linked from README

issues.title: API client with JWT refresh
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] dio client with base URL from settings
- [ ] Interceptor attaches the access token and refreshes on 401 once
- [ ] Tokens stored with secure storage on Android and Windows
- [ ] Typed errors (offline, validation, conflict, unauthorized)

issues.title: Login and register screens
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Register (email, username, password) and login forms with validation
- [ ] Logout in settings
- [ ] The app stays fully usable when logged out

issues.title: Publish quizzes and decks
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] "Publish" on owned items: `POST` first time, `PUT` with `If-Match` afterwards
- [ ] Visibility choice: public / unlisted / private
- [ ] On 409 the user chooses "keep mine (overwrite)" or "take server version"
- [ ] Stores `remoteId` / `remoteVersion` locally

issues.title: Catalog browse and search screen
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Tabs for quizzes and decks, search box, tag filter, sort, infinite scroll
- [ ] Details page with description, owner, question/card count, downloads
- [ ] Friendly offline state

issues.title: Download content and show available updates
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] "Download" stores the document with `origin = downloaded`, `remoteId`, `remoteVersion`, owner name
- [ ] Library shows "Update available" when the server version is newer; updating keeps attempts and review progress

issues.title: Read-only downloaded content and "Make a copy"
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Downloaded items not owned by the user open read-only
- [ ] "Make a copy" creates a local item with a new id that can be edited and published

issues.title: Responsive desktop layout
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Two-pane layouts on wide screens (e.g. library + details, editor + preview)
- [ ] Keyboard shortcuts documented in a help dialog
- [ ] Sensible minimum window size on Windows

issues.title: Theming and dark mode
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Light / dark / system theme setting
- [ ] Charts and code-colored states readable in both themes

issues.title: Accessibility pass
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Semantics labels on custom widgets, focus order works with keyboard
- [ ] Text scaling up to 200% without overflow
- [ ] Contrast checked; correct/incorrect not shown by color alone

issues.title: Integration tests: create → play → stats
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] Integration test creates a quiz, plays it, and checks results and stats
- [ ] Integration test for a flashcard study session
- [ ] Runs on Windows in CI

issues.title: Android and Windows release builds
issues.body:
**Done when**
- [ ] App id, name StudyBetter and icons set for both platforms
- [ ] Signed Android APK/AAB (signing via CI secrets)
- [ ] Windows release build (zip or MSIX)
- [ ] CI builds artifacts on `main` and attaches them to GitHub releases
